_NOT_IMPORTABLE: Reference only. This is NOT an Open WebUI config export and must never be imported or applied. It records what the runbook expects to find; set things by hand in the admin UI and verify with inspect_config.py. Contains no endpoints, credentials, accounts, or paths.
_applies_to: Open WebUI 0.11.4 only (source-read; live behaviour unverified)
_persisted_vs_effective: inspect_config.py reads persisted config rows only. Effective runtime settings can differ when environment variables override them or when a key has no row; confirm in the live admin UI.

memories.system_context.enable.why: default; injects the user's memories into the prompt of whichever model the chat uses

memories.background_review.enable.why: when true the server asks an LLM to add/replace/remove memories after every N turns with no user confirmation; must stay off

rag.embedding_engine.why: empty string = built-in in-process sentence-transformers; no configured embedding endpoint is called (this does not prove network silence: model download/load or hub traffic is not excluded; keep a live egress check)

rag.embedding_model.why: retain the existing MiniLM; do not change the embedding model (changing it would require re-embedding every memory)

rag.ollama.base_url / rag.openai.api_bas.why: may be stored as JSON objects (or arrays of objects) that also hold credential fields; the inspector projects only the nested url inside SQLite and never selects the object. Under strict local-only an Ollama embedding URL must be loopback; a private-network address fails and a container host alias is reported UNVERIFIED

rag.relevance_threshold.why: 0 means the nearest memories are injected regardless of similarity; a small positive value reduces unrelated injection (not changed by this repo)

chat.tool_permissions.enable.why: NOT relied on: approval mode is a client-supplied per-chat parameter and does not guard memory writes made by background review

task.model.default / task.model.external.why: auxiliary tasks (titles, tags, queries) follow these; confirm they resolve to a local model before using private text

every model, local or external: Builtin.why: default is ON; ON exposes add/update/replace/delete memory tools to the model with no enforced confirmation, so any model could initiate a write

dedicated local memory model only: Capab.why: lets the standard Memory context reach this local model only

any external/remote model: Capabilities.why: memory text is placed in the prompt sent to the selected model's endpoint

live_gates: exact Settings UI placement of Memory controls, including whether a per-entry delete action exists (the delete API is source-read; the UI control is unverified)
outbound connections of the Open WebUI process, including MiniLM download/load or hub traffic
effective settings when environment variables override persisted rows
whether any host alias or private-network embedding URL really points at this machine
